notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The Forest Lookouts page and the firetower.org page both give 2000 as the removal date; only the firetower.org page names Connecticut as the destination. No source read gives a build date, design, builder, staffing or fires, so the story has none. The Connecticut town or owner is unknown, so the tower's current location is unknown. Unread search snippets claim a 1946 or 1949 build, a Blackstrap Hill (Falmouth) origin and a 1999 removal; these conflict with the 2000 date in the pages read and were not used, pending a check against Maine Forest Service records. The brief's FFLOS registration date (2008) matches the cached register page ('Date Registered September 15, 2008'); the story does not use it.
